explanation: One of Jacob's twelve sons and the ancestor of the tribe of Judah.
Judah's daughter-in-law who pretends to be a prostitute in order to become pregnant by him.
Judah's firstborn son, who dies because of his wickedness in God's sight.
Judah's second son, who also dies after refusing to fulfill his duty as a brother-in-law (levirate marriage) toward Tamar.
Judah's third son, whom Tamar was supposed to marry, but whom Judah does not give her in marriage.
One of the twin sons born to Tamar and Judah, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus.
The other twin son born to Tamar and Judah.
